description: Administer a sports league from structure setup through season management to championships.

steps.description: Define the league structure including divisions, age groups, skill levels, and rules of play.

inputs.name: participant-pool
inputs.desc: Description of the expected participants (number, ages, skill range)

outputs.name: league-structure
outputs.desc: Divisions, age groups, skill tiers, and league rules

outputs.name: eligibility-criteria
outputs.desc: Requirements for teams and players to participate

process: Define the divisions based on age group, skill level, or geography.
Set the rules of play, game length, and scoring system.
Document the eligibility criteria for teams and individual players.
Produce the league structure document.

steps.description: Manage team registrations, fees, and roster submissions for the league.

inputs.name: league-structure
inputs.desc: Divisions and eligibility criteria from league setup

outputs.name: registered-teams
outputs.desc: List of registered teams with rosters and division assignments

outputs.name: registration-ledger
outputs.desc: Record of fees collected and registration status per team

process: Open registration and collect team applications with rosters.
Verify each team and player against the eligibility criteria.
Collect registration fees and assign teams to divisions.
Close registration and produce the registration ledger.

steps.description: Create the season schedule with matchups, dates, times, and venue assignments.

outputs.name: season-schedule
outputs.desc: Complete schedule of games with dates, times, matchups, and venues

outputs.name: venue-assignments
outputs.desc: Venue and field allocation for each game

process: Determine the number of games per team based on the league format (round robin, partial round robin).
Generate matchups ensuring balanced home and away assignments.
Assign dates, times, and venues to each game avoiding conflicts.
Publish the season schedule.

steps.description: Assign referees, umpires, and other officials to scheduled games.

inputs.name: season-schedule
inputs.desc: The game schedule with dates and venues

outputs.name: official-assignments
outputs.desc: Officials assigned to each game

outputs.name: official-schedule
outputs.desc: Per-official schedule showing their assigned games

process: Inventory the available officials and their certifications.
Assign officials to games based on availability, location, and conflict-of-interest rules.
Distribute the official schedule and confirm availability.
Produce the assignment record.

steps.description: Track game results, standings, and player or team statistics throughout the season.

outputs.name: league-standings
outputs.desc: Current standings for each division (wins, losses, ties, points)

outputs.name: season-statistics
outputs.desc: Player and team statistics for the season

process: Collect game results from officials or team managers after each game.
Update standings tables for each division.
Compile individual and team statistics.
Publish updated standings and statistics on the regular cadence.

steps.description: Manage the playoff bracket and championship based on regular season standings.

inputs.name: season-statistics
inputs.desc: Statistics used for tiebreakers and seeding

outputs.name: playoff-bracket
outputs.desc: Seeded playoff bracket with matchups and schedule

outputs.name: championship-record
outputs.desc: Final results, champion, and season summary

process: Determine playoff qualifiers from final standings using tiebreaker rules.
Seed the playoff bracket and schedule the games.
Track results through each round and advance winners.
Record the championship results and produce the season summary.

description: Run a tournament from format selection and seeding through bracket play to final standings.

steps.description: Select the tournament format based on the number of participants, time constraints, and goals.

inputs.name: participant-count
inputs.desc: Number of teams or individuals entered

inputs.name: tournament-constraints
inputs.desc: Available time, venues, and format preferences

outputs.name: tournament-format
outputs.desc: Selected format (single elimination, double elimination, round robin, Swiss) with rationale

outputs.name: format-rules
outputs.desc: Rules specific to the selected format (byes, seeding, tiebreakers)

process: Evaluate the participant count against available time and venues.
Select the format that fits the constraints (single elimination for speed, round robin for fairness, Swiss for large fields).
Define the tiebreaker and bye rules for the selected format.
Document the format and rules.

steps.description: Seed participants into the bracket based on rankings, ratings, or prior results.

outputs.name: seeded-bracket
outputs.desc: Initial bracket with participants placed by seed

outputs.name: seeding-rationale
outputs.desc: Explanation of how seeds were determined

process: Collect ranking or rating data for each participant.
Apply the seeding algorithm (highest seeds placed to meet latest).
Assign byes to top seeds if the field is not a power of two.
Produce the seeded bracket.

steps.description: Manage each round of the bracket: record results, advance winners, handle withdrawals.

outputs.name: updated-bracket
outputs.desc: Bracket updated through all completed rounds

outputs.name: match-results-log
outputs.desc: Record of each match result and any incidents

process: For each round, confirm matchups and schedule times and venues.
Record results as matches complete and advance winners.
Handle withdrawals by advancing the opponent or replacing from the waitlist per the format rules.
Update the bracket after each round.

steps.description: Record the final match results and produce the final standings and awards.

inputs.name: updated-bracket
inputs.desc: Bracket through to the final round

outputs.name: final-standings
outputs.desc: Final placement of all participants

outputs.name: tournament-record
outputs.desc: Complete tournament record (bracket, results, awards, statistics)

process: Run the final and consolation matches.
Determine final standings for all participants.
Record awards (champion, runner-up, MVP, sportsmanship).
Produce the complete tournament record.

description: Set up and manage a booking system for sports facilities, fields, courts, and rooms.

steps.description: Inventory all bookable spaces with their attributes and availability windows.

inputs.name: facility-list
inputs.desc: List of facilities or spaces to be made bookable

inputs.name: operating-parameters
inputs.desc: Hours of operation, maintenance windows, seasonal closures

outputs.name: space-catalog
outputs.desc: Catalog of bookable spaces with capacity, equipment, and features

outputs.name: availability-windows
outputs.desc: Default availability for each space by day and time

process: List each bookable space with its type (field, court, pool lane, meeting room).
Record the capacity, equipment, surface type, and lighting for each space.
Define the default availability windows and any recurring maintenance blocks.
Produce the space catalog.

steps.description: Define the booking rules including advance notice, duration limits, priority groups, and pricing.

outputs.name: booking-rules
outputs.desc: Complete ruleset (advance booking window, max duration, cancellation policy, priority tiers)

outputs.name: pricing-schedule
outputs.desc: Rates by space type, time slot, and user group

process: Set the advance booking window (how far ahead bookings can be made).
Define maximum and minimum booking durations.
Establish priority groups (residents, members, league play, public) and their booking windows.
Set the pricing and cancellation/refund policy.

steps.description: Handle booking conflicts, double bookings, and waitlist management.

inputs.name: booking-rules
inputs.desc: Rules governing priority and conflict resolution

inputs.name: pricing-schedule
inputs.desc: Rates for reference in conflict scenarios

outputs.name: conflict-resolution-protocol
outputs.desc: Procedures for resolving booking conflicts

outputs.name: waitlist-procedures
outputs.desc: How waitlists are managed and notifications sent

process: Define the priority order for resolving overlapping requests.
Set up the waitlist with automatic notification when a slot opens.
Establish the escalation path for disputes.
Document the conflict resolution protocol.

steps.description: Track facility utilization rates and produce reports for planning and budgeting.

outputs.name: utilization-report
outputs.desc: Utilization rates by space, time period, and user group

outputs.name: demand-analysis
outputs.desc: Analysis of peak demand, waitlist frequency, and unmet demand

process: Collect booking data (reservations, cancellations, no-shows) for the reporting period.
Calculate utilization rate for each space and time slot.
Analyze waitlist data to identify unmet demand.
Produce the utilization and demand report.

description: Manage a team roster from player registration through eligibility verification to in-season transactions.

steps.description: Collect player registrations with personal information, waivers, and supporting documents.

inputs.name: roster-requirements
inputs.desc: League rules for roster size, age, and documentation

outputs.name: registration-submissions
outputs.desc: All submitted player registrations with documents

outputs.name: missing-items-list
outputs.desc: Players with incomplete submissions

process: Distribute the registration form (personal info, emergency contact, medical, waivers).
Collect completed forms and supporting documents (birth certificate, proof of residency).
Flag incomplete submissions and follow up for missing items.
Compile all submissions into the registration file.

steps.description: Verify each player's eligibility against league rules.

inputs.name: missing-items-list
inputs.desc: Outstanding items to resolve before verification

outputs.name: verified-players
outputs.desc: Players confirmed eligible with documentation on file

outputs.name: ineligible-players
outputs.desc: Players who do not meet eligibility requirements with reasons

process: Check each player's age against the division age cutoff.
Verify residency or membership requirements.
Confirm medical clearance and signed waivers are on file.
Produce the eligibility determination for each player.

steps.description: Assign jersey numbers, positions, and roles to build the official roster.

outputs.name: official-roster
outputs.desc: Finalized roster with jersey numbers, positions, and roles

outputs.name: roster-submission-record
outputs.desc: Record submitted to the league for certification

process: Assign jersey numbers avoiding duplicates and honoring requests where possible.
Record each player's primary and secondary positions.
Designate team captain and any other roles.
Submit the roster to the league for certification.

steps.description: Handle in-season roster transactions: adds, drops, trades, and injury replacements.

outputs.name: updated-roster
outputs.desc: Roster reflecting all in-season transactions

outputs.name: transaction-log
outputs.desc: Record of all roster moves with dates and league approvals

process: Receive the transaction request (add, drop, trade, injury replacement).
Verify the transaction complies with league rules (trade deadline, roster limits, eligibility).
Submit the transaction to the league for approval.
Update the roster and record the transaction.

description: Run a youth sports program from division setup and registration through season operations and parent communication.

steps.description: Design age-appropriate divisions with modified rules for youth play.

inputs.name: sport-type
inputs.desc: The sport being organized for youth

inputs.name: age-range
inputs.desc: The age range of participants in the program

outputs.name: youth-divisions
outputs.desc: Division structure with age groups and modified rules for each

outputs.name: safety-guidelines
outputs.desc: Safety rules and equipment requirements by age group

process: Define age group cutoffs (typically 2-year bands).
Modify game rules for each age group (field size, game length, scoring, substitution rules).
Set equipment requirements and safety guidelines for each division.
Document the division structure.

steps.description: Manage youth registrations, fees, scholarships, and family discounts.

outputs.name: registered-youth
outputs.desc: Registered participants assigned to divisions

outputs.name: fee-ledger
outputs.desc: Fees collected, scholarships applied, and outstanding balances

process: Open registration with the fee schedule and scholarship application.
Collect registrations, medical forms, and waivers signed by a parent or guardian.
Process fees, apply family discounts and scholarships.
Assign participants to divisions and produce the registration record.

steps.description: Recruit, screen, and train volunteer coaches for the youth program.

inputs.name: registered-youth
inputs.desc: Number of teams needed based on registrations

inputs.name: fee-ledger
inputs.desc: Budget available for coach training materials

outputs.name: approved-coaches
outputs.desc: Coaches who passed screening and completed training

outputs.name: coaching-assignments
outputs.desc: Coach-to-team assignments

process: Recruit volunteer coaches from the parent community.
Run background checks on all coaching applicants.
Provide coaching training (sport fundamentals, age-appropriate instruction, safety, positive coaching).
Assign coaches to teams.

steps.description: Schedule practices and games for all youth divisions.

inputs.name: approved-coaches
inputs.desc: Available coaches and their schedule constraints

outputs.name: practice-schedule
outputs.desc: Practice times and locations for each team

outputs.name: game-schedule
outputs.desc: Game schedule with dates, times, matchups, and venues

process: Collect coach and facility availability.
Schedule practices with one or two sessions per week per team.
Generate the game schedule balancing home and away, early and late time slots.
Distribute schedules to coaches and families.

steps.description: Handle uniform and equipment distribution and end-of-season return.

inputs.name: practice-schedule
inputs.desc: When teams start so equipment is distributed in time

outputs.name: equipment-ledger
outputs.desc: Record of items distributed to each participant

outputs.name: return-status
outputs.desc: Items returned, missing, or damaged at season end

process: Inventory available uniforms and equipment by size.
Distribute uniforms and equipment at team formation, recording each item by participant.
Schedule and run equipment return at season end.
Reconcile the inventory against distributions and produce the equipment ledger.

steps.description: Manage communications with parents including schedules, updates, weather cancellations, and feedback.

outputs.name: communication-log
outputs.desc: Record of all communications sent to parents

outputs.name: parent-feedback-summary
outputs.desc: Compiled parent feedback and satisfaction data

process: Set up the communication channel (email list, team app, text group).
Send regular updates (schedule changes, weather cancellations, picture day, events).
Collect parent feedback through a mid-season and end-of-season survey.
Compile feedback and produce the communication log.

description: Manage game day operations from venue preparation through game play to post-game closeout.

steps.description: Prepare the venue for game day: field setup, equipment check, scoreboard, and safety inspection.

inputs.name: game-details
inputs.desc: Teams, time, venue, officials, and any special requirements

inputs.name: venue-requirements
inputs.desc: Setup specifications for the sport and level of play

outputs.name: venue-readiness-report
outputs.desc: Confirmation that the venue is ready with any issues noted

outputs.name: equipment-check-record
outputs.desc: Record of equipment inspected and in place

process: Set up the playing surface (lines, goals, nets, bases, court markings).
Inspect safety equipment and first aid supplies.
Test the scoreboard, clock, and public address system.
Complete the venue readiness checklist.

steps.description: Brief officials, staff, and team managers on the game day procedures.

inputs.name: venue-readiness-report
inputs.desc: Venue status and any issues to communicate

outputs.name: briefing-record
outputs.desc: Attendance and items covered in the pre-game briefing

outputs.name: game-roster-sheets
outputs.desc: Verified rosters submitted by each team

process: Confirm official and staff attendance and assignments.
Review the ground rules, any venue-specific notes, and safety procedures.
Collect and verify game rosters from each team.
Record the briefing.

steps.description: Run the game operations: scoring, timekeeping, substitutions, and in-game management.

outputs.name: game-result
outputs.desc: Final score, period scores, and key events

outputs.name: game-log
outputs.desc: Play-by-play or event log (goals, fouls, substitutions, injuries, ejections)

process: Manage warmups and the start-of-game procedures.
Operate the scoreboard and clock, recording scoring plays and penalties.
Track substitutions, timeouts, and any stoppages.
Record the final result and any incidents.

steps.description: Handle post-game tasks: results reporting, incident documentation, and venue breakdown.

outputs.name: results-submission
outputs.desc: Official result submitted to the league or tournament

outputs.name: incident-reports
outputs.desc: Any incident reports filed (injuries, ejections, protests)

process: Submit the official result to the league or tournament system.
File incident reports for any injuries, ejections, or protests.
Break down the venue and secure equipment.
Produce the game day record.

description: Design and manage a periodized athletic training program from assessment through in-season tracking.

steps.description: Assess athletes through fitness testing, injury history review, and goal setting.

inputs.name: sport-demands
inputs.desc: Physical demands and performance benchmarks for the sport

outputs.name: assessment-results
outputs.desc: Fitness test scores, injury history, and baseline measurements for each athlete

outputs.name: athlete-goals
outputs.desc: Individual goals for each athlete based on assessment and sport demands

process: Administer fitness tests (strength, speed, agility, endurance, flexibility).
Review each athlete's injury history and current limitations.
Set individual goals based on test results and sport-specific demands.
Produce the assessment report.

steps.description: Design the periodized training plan covering off-season, pre-season, in-season, and recovery phases.

inputs.name: assessment-results
inputs.desc: Baseline fitness data for the team

outputs.name: training-plan
outputs.desc: Periodized plan with phases, volume, intensity, and focus areas

outputs.name: phase-calendar
outputs.desc: Calendar mapping each training phase to dates

process: Define the macrocycle (annual plan) with phase dates aligned to the competition schedule.
Design each mesocycle (3-6 week block) with volume, intensity, and training focus.
Build in deload weeks and transition periods between phases.
Produce the periodized training plan.

steps.description: Program the specific workouts for each training phase.

outputs.name: workout-library
outputs.desc: Programmed workouts for each day in each phase

outputs.name: exercise-database
outputs.desc: Exercise descriptions, progressions, and alternatives

process: Select exercises for each phase based on the training focus (strength, power, endurance, sport-specific).
Set the sets, reps, load, and rest for each exercise.
Include warm-up, cool-down, and mobility work.
Produce the workout library.

steps.description: Track athlete progress through the training program and adjust based on performance data.

outputs.name: progress-report
outputs.desc: Performance tracking data showing improvement, plateaus, and regressions

outputs.name: program-adjustments
outputs.desc: Modifications made to the plan based on monitoring data

process: Log training loads and performance markers for each session.
Compare current performance to baseline and phase targets.
Identify athletes who are ahead, on track, or behind, and adjust the plan accordingly.
Produce the progress report with adjustment notes.

description: Set up a sports registration system with forms, payments, capacity management, and confirmations.

steps.description: Design the registration form with all required fields, waivers, and document uploads.

inputs.name: program-details
inputs.desc: The program being registered for (sport, divisions, dates, costs)

inputs.name: data-requirements
inputs.desc: Required participant information, waivers, and supporting documents

outputs.name: form-design
outputs.desc: Registration form layout with all fields, validation rules, and conditional logic

outputs.name: waiver-templates
outputs.desc: Liability waiver and media release templates

process: Define the required fields (participant info, emergency contact, medical, allergies).
Add the waiver and media release with digital signature.
Set conditional fields (e.g., medical details only if a condition is indicated).
Produce the form design.

steps.description: Configure payment processing for registration fees including early bird, family discounts, and scholarships.

inputs.name: form-design
inputs.desc: Registration form to integrate payment into

inputs.name: waiver-templates
inputs.desc: Documents that must be signed before payment

outputs.name: payment-configuration
outputs.desc: Fee structure, discount rules, scholarship application, and refund policy

outputs.name: payment-processor-setup
outputs.desc: Payment processor integration details

process: Define the fee schedule with early bird, standard, and late registration pricing.
Configure family and multi-sport discount rules.
Set up the scholarship application and approval workflow.
Document the refund and cancellation policy.

steps.description: Manage division and program capacity limits, waitlists, and overflow handling.

inputs.name: payment-configuration
inputs.desc: Fee and refund rules for waitlisted registrants

outputs.name: capacity-status
outputs.desc: Real-time capacity status for each division and program

outputs.name: waitlist-queue
outputs.desc: Ordered waitlist with notification preferences

process: Set capacity limits for each division and program.
When capacity is reached, move new registrations to the waitlist.
When a spot opens (cancellation or added capacity), notify the next waitlisted registrant.
Track waitlist conversion rates for future planning.

steps.description: Confirm registrations and distribute program information to participants.

outputs.name: confirmation-record
outputs.desc: All confirmations sent with participant details and payment receipts

outputs.name: program-info-package
outputs.desc: Information package distributed to confirmed participants (schedule, rules, contacts)

process: Send registration confirmation with payment receipt.
Distribute the information package (schedule, rules, equipment list, contacts, venue directions).
Send waitlist status notifications with expected timeline.
Produce the confirmation and distribution record.
